page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre. Below the last line, at the foot, the signature "B 2" on the left and the catchword "illam" on the right. No marginal notes on this page. The strip at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: uere[?] studebat, omnesq; ad pacem & concor-diam, quantum fieri posset, revocare, existi-mabam, operam non inutilem futuram, si a-liqua concordia ineunde ratio excogitari po-tuerint. Sed quum res ipsas propius perspexe-rim, videbatur concordia quaerenda studium ex bono quidem animo proficisci[?], sed impossi-bilia tentare eos, qui post Decreta Tridentina reconciliationem aut concordiam cogitant. Ante Concilium illud Tridentinum facti-tius hoc negotium expediri potuisse videba-tur. Quamuis enim in multis doctrina ca-pitibus corruptela subintroducta fuerant à fraterculis, in praecipuis tamen articulis, & fundamentalibus videmus integritatem doctrina à multis mirifica Dei providentia conseruatam[?]: ita ut in dubio pendere videretur ante Concilium Tridentinum, quaenam fuerit Ecclesia Romana doctrina, illa-ne, quam multi viri religiosi integram re-tinuerunt, an potius illa, quam pseudofra-tres induxerunt. Hinc ardor & studium animum meum invaserat, inquirendi hu-ius mutationis origines. Animatus etiam fui ad hunc laborem à Reverendissimo Ar-chiepiscopo Cantuariensi, qui, quum forte ante aliquot annos de origine errorum Tri-dentinorum sermo fuisset iniectus, operam illam

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the first word of the page (printed "uere" or "vere", the first letter unclear, marked [?]); "proficisci" (marked [?]); "conseruatam" (the scan is blurred at the u/n letters, marked [?]). The printed spelling "Reuerendissimo" is normalised to "Reverendissimo" under the u/v rule. The page starts mid-sentence, so the first paragraph has cont="true".
